record.question: According to Section 3 of the Mizoram Police Act, 2011, what does the concept of "One Police Service" signify?
options: That each district in Mizoram maintains its own independent police service

There shall be one Police Service for the State of Mizoram. Members of the Police Service shall be liable for posting to any branch of the Service in the state, excluding any of its specialized wings.
There shall be one Police Service for the State of Mizoram. Members of thePolice Service shall be liable for posting to any branch of the Service in the state, including any of its specialized wings.
That the police are divided into civil, military, and investigative wings
record.explanation: There is one police service for the state, with posting to any branch including specialized wings.
